posts.title: Favorite Blogs
posts.description: The blogs below are some of my favorites to read. I like reading about things I find interesting. For me, that’s AI/ML, product management, history, and the business of tech. I prefer less frequent but in-depth posts, so the selections below skew toward that style of posting. I’m old-school so still use an RSS Reader ( Reeder via Feedly ); longer articles go to Instapaper for a batch weekend read.
